title: 第十三章 善堂立威第十四章 规矩不能破
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
眉宇间都是局促。
眼神飘忽不敢看林枫，生怕林枫嫌弃。
林枫笑道：“行，没问题，今天先尝尝郑师弟的手艺”
“林师兄，要稍微等会”
一个时辰左右，兔肉终于熟了。
郑宏文揭开锅盖，顿时一股香气袭来。
一脸享受的吸了一口。
“哇真是太香了”
随即，迫不及待捞了一碗肉递给了林枫。
“林师兄，快尝尝看”
林枫点头，拿起一块肉吃了一口，忍不住眼睛一亮。
“这野兔肉味道真不错，只放盐都这么香”
这倒不是恭维，是真心觉得兔肉不错。
兔肉滋滋冒油，回味无穷。
同时也是林枫头次吃到这边的肉食。
“这可是托了林师兄的福，要不然今天可吃不到这么好吃的兔肉”郑宏文也是吃的满嘴是油。
“下次有机会还找你”
“哦对了，林师兄这汤你还要吗？”
“要这干嘛？明天就坏了”
“坏不了，留着泡饼吃，那叫一个香”

“下次请你喝酒”
这次有些失算，应该来之前就带着酒。
原本林枫想着应该不怎么好吃，没想到这肉还真不错。
“喝酒太贵了，还是不用了”郑宏文眼神闪过一丝期待，但还是摇摇头。
“想喝酒下次请你，吃着兔肉喝着酒，那真是美味。
这野兔肉吃上瘾了”
“这算啥，妖兽肉那才叫一个香啊，吃完气血畅通，可惜就是太贵了”
闻言，林枫来了兴趣。
尽管赵二豹的记忆中有关妖兽肉的模糊记忆。
黑莲反馈的记忆信息，都是一些重要记忆或者特殊事件以及能力。
其它吃喝拉撒无关琐事的记忆根本没有。
没有吃过妖兽肉的林枫，还真想尝一尝。
“妖兽肉多少钱？”
“妖兽肉太贵了，3两银子一斤肉”
林枫：“哦这么贵？”
“嗯，但是效果也非常好，妖兽肉对我们这些炼体境练武者作用很大。
能增强骨头的硬度，如果天天都有妖兽肉的辅助，那修炼的速度非常快”郑宏文眼神闪过一丝憧憬。
这倒是觉得让林枫有些意外，郑宏文都这么穷了，竟然还能吃上妖兽肉？
难道是个吃货？
把家里吃穷了？
content_en:
The eyebrows are cramped.
His eyes were wandering and he didn't dare to look at Lin Feng, for fear that Lin Feng would dislike him.
Lin Feng smiled and said: "Okay, no problem. Let's try Junior Brother Zheng's craftsmanship today."
"Senior Brother Lin, please wait a moment."
After about an hour, the rabbit meat was finally cooked.
Zheng Hongwen opened the lid of the pot, and an aroma suddenly hit him.
He took a sip with a look of enjoyment.
“Wow it smells so good”
Immediately, he eagerly scooped up a bowl of meat and handed it to Lin Feng.
"Senior Brother Lin, try it quickly."
Lin Feng nodded, picked up a piece of meat and took a bite, his eyes lit up.
"This hare meat tastes really good, even with just the salt."
This is not a compliment, I really think rabbit meat is good.
The rabbit meat is sizzling and oily, leaving an endless aftertaste.
It was also the first time Lin Feng had eaten meat here.
"This is all thanks to Senior Brother Lin, otherwise I wouldn't be able to eat such delicious rabbit meat today." Zheng Hongwen also ate with his mouth full of oil.
“I’ll see you next time I have a chance.”
"Oh, by the way, do you want this soup, Senior Brother Lin?"
"Why do you want this? It will be broken tomorrow."
"It won't spoil. Keep the puff pastry to eat. It's delicious."
"I'll treat you to a drink next time"
I made some miscalculation this time, I should have brought wine with me before I came.
Originally, Lin Feng thought it wouldn't be very tasty, but he didn't expect the meat to be really good.
"Drinking is too expensive, so I won't use it." Zheng Hongwen's eyes flashed with anticipation, but he still shook his head.
"I'll treat you to a drink next time. Eat rabbit meat and drink wine. It's really delicious.
I’m addicted to eating this hare meat.”
"What does this mean? Monster meat is so delicious. After eating it, your energy and blood flow smoothly. Unfortunately, it's too expensive."
Hearing this, Lin Feng became interested.
Although Zhao Erbao has vague memories of monster meat.
The memory information fed back by Black Lotus are all important memories or special events and abilities.
There are no memories of other trivial matters such as eating, drinking and having diarrhea.
Lin Feng, who had never eaten monster meat before, really wanted to try it.
"How much does monster meat cost?"
"Monster meat is too expensive, 3 taels of silver per pound of meat."
Lin Feng: "Oh, so expensive?"
"Yes, but the effect is also very good. Monster meat is very useful to us body refining realm martial arts practitioners.
It can enhance the hardness of bones. If you have the help of monster meat every day, your cultivation speed will be very fast." Zheng Hongwen's eyes flashed with longing.
This seems to surprise Lin Feng. Zheng Hongwen is so poor, but he can still eat monster meat?
Are you a foodie?
Is your family poor?
